subject: prd/impl-review
statement: The persisted review corpus shall be mechanically harvestable by joining immutable git event records to their proposal projections without reading free text, reproducing findings, attribution-bound dispositions, planned assurance, actual band, effective depth, required/completed passes, per-pass route/outcome and verdict, aggregate result, review presence/absence, and invalidation state; only a losslessly consistent satisfying complete pass set shall count toward production coverage.
rationale: the dataset must expose floor, route, and independence violations rather than letting an editable projection, skip, or favorable subset appear reviewed
fit_criterion: a fresh-clone harvest over git plus both proposal media reproduces the dogfood corpus, rejects face mismatches, computes M1/M2/nit and matrix coverage, excludes unattributable dispositions and invalid/stale/incomplete processes, and counts `skip` only after `standard×1` completion
